full_judgment: 10. In another decision "Md. Masaddar Hoque Vs. State" reported in 10 D.L.R. (S.C) 29. Where the facts runs as follows:- "That Jahuruddin Bepari presented a Kabuliyat for registration and the Sub-Registrar demanded Tk. 15/- as allillegal gratification for registration. The complainant reported the matter to the Sub-Inspector DAB, and a trap was laid but the Sub-Registrar did not register the Kabuliyat and take the gratification on that date but on the subsequent date when the complainant presented the Kabuliyat for registration the Sub-Registrar Mosaddar Hoque asked for and received Rs. 15/- from the complainant as bribe, registered the document and asked him to pay the registration fee of Rs. 6/- to the Moharer. But when complainant offered the amount of Rs. 6/- the Moharer demanded Rs. 1/- more saying that if he was not paid, he would not at- tend his work. Complainant thereupon paid Rs. 7/- in all and the Inspector of Police, D.A.B. and the Magistrate recovered the amount and arrested these two accused who were charged u/s 406. These two accused namely the Sub-Registrar and Moharer were tried jointly taking that the offences were the same and were committed in the course of same transaction. It was held in that decision that joint trial of the two accused persons was illegal. It could not be said that the acts of the two accused were in p vrsuance of any design or scheme. There was no common object in the sense that one helped the other in receiving an illegal gratification.
